notes: Aimtell has no text-free mark in a usable size; every logo is raster. I chose the app icon the site itself declares for iOS (rule 1: the logo as it appears as an app icon), larger than the current 192px file. The green tile is the brand's own (manifest background #009933). DECISION: alternatives, all Aimtell's own: (a) aimtell.com/favicon.ico, the only text-free symbol (a green speech bubble with three dots), but it is a 32px PNG (downloads/aimtell/src3/favicon.ico); (b) the docs' source of the current file, mintcdn.com/aimtell/.../aimtelllogo-square.png, the same green wordmark on transparent at 2310px (downloads/aimtell/src4); (c) dashboard.aimtell.com's touch icon, a generic white bell on green, JPG 2060px (downloads/aimtell/src7), not the brand mark. The tiny "Powered by DMS" caption is unreadable at 48px.
